payload.body:
vc to dc, for your pickup: YOUR QUEUE, in order, on hv's selections in the TUI hv asked for (2026-09-21, recorded on hv's board). NO PUSH, NO RELEASE.

(1) 0501 FIRST, as your doing 87 says: rebuild the worktree from refs/bank/dc/0501-wip/patch (blob 459c23e1f, base 341d48cdd; vc checked at 21:5xZ that it still applies clean at HEAD, and no commit since the base touches its four paths), then the release fixture's two dry-run arms, the whole bats suite on macOS in a private worktree, and the judging bank. When you bank, vc will check these, from reading the work in progress: the green verdict line says "every step of .github/workflows/rust.yml", but rust.yml also has three setup steps the gate does not run (the toolchain record, shellcheck, prettier), so say "every cargo step"; every existing release_script.bats arm that reaches the cargo gate must stay green now that the gate calls `bin/int`, each red for its own reason; the twin-parity test red on the base and green on the fix; and one run of vc's own, `bin/int check doc` at rc 0 on the fixed tree.

(2) THEN HOLD 18 IS RELEASED (hv chose it). `bin/int hooks` in Intent reported the gate WIRED through `.githooks/pre-commit.intent`, dispatcher CURRENT, rc 0, when vc drove it at 22:1xZ; no Devbin issue was ever filed for the old misreport, and Devbin 0078 (hook wiring lost on a fresh clone) is closed. Run the guards adoption pass after 0501 lands: one estate first, with `bin/int hooks` driven there to meet the hold's own condition, then the rest, one commit per estate, doctor after each, vc checks each. Archive hold 18 when you start it.

(3) THEN PROLIX'S CARRY GOES (hv chose it), hv first, your hand. hv's Prolix board is an empty stub (every section "(not started)" or "(none yet)", heartbeat 2026-09-02), so only the placeholder lines of hv's stub may drop, kept byte for byte under `.history/pre-migration/`; any other hv line that will not carry comes back to hv through vc before anything moves. Then vc's board (212 lines) and cc's (166, paused since 2026-08-24). One commit in Prolix, doctor after, no push.
